title: Coefficient of an extracted pivot
statement: Let $\nu$ be a finite set, choose a variable $v\in\nu$, and consider a list of linear equations over $\mathbb F_2$, each with a coefficient for every variable. If extracting a pivot equation at $v$ from the list returns an equation $E$ and a remaining list, then the coefficient of $v$ in $E$ is $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $\nu$ is a finite type with decidable equality
The pivot extraction returns the pair consisting of $E$ and a remaining list
